Altara – Elegant Modern Serif Font

Altara is a sophisticated modern serif typeface designed to bring an elegant, refined, and editorial character to your creative projects. Its high-contrast letterforms, graceful curves, sharp details, and balanced proportions create a premium visual style that works beautifully across both luxury and contemporary designs.

With its fashion-forward personality, Altara is ideal for designers looking to create an upscale and memorable visual identity. It works especially well for luxury fashion, beauty and cosmetics, perfume branding, editorial layouts, magazines, boutique identities, packaging, art direction, posters, invitations, and premium product branding.
